briefdescription.para: Runs one epoch.

detaileddescription.para: The function deletes the old samples file. It starts a Sampler when the manifest has a ## sample table. It launches command manifest in the manifest folder and waits until the command ends. It then drains the Sampler and reads the samples file through addEpoch. It adds the wall time of the epoch, in ns, to the epoch samples. On all systems it also adds the user and system time of the child, in ns, to the user and system samples. It last pads each row that has no sample in this epoch with zero.

simplesect.para: Ok when all steps succeed. Otherwise the first failure: \<command path\>: command failed when the command does not exit with 0, the failure of the Sampler when it cannot start, read or stop, or not found: \<samples path\> when the command writes no samples file.

memberdef.name: getProfiles

briefdescription.para: Returns the profiles of all epochs.

detaileddescription.para: The tree holds one table for each table type, with one row for each zone. For each table type that holds bins, it also holds a table of the type \<TYPE\>_CALLS. That table has one row for each zone that holds bins, with the percentile property. Its statistics come from the merged bins of all epochs. The last table is the run table that the samples file holds. Each zone that the matching table of baseline also holds adds the comparison properties.

parameterdescription.para: Tree of an earlier report. It may hold no matching table.

briefdescription.para: Runs a command once for each epoch and collects its samples.

detaileddescription.para: Each epoch runs the command and reads the samples file that the command writes. When the manifest has a ## sample table, each epoch also runs a Sampler. The object keeps one set of data for each table type: the table type of the samples file, sample and cswitch. For each table type it keeps the epoch samples, the calls, the units and the merged bins of each row. The epoch, user and system rows belong to the table type of the samples file. getProfiles builds the profiles from them.
